title: てぃんさぐぬ花 (Tensagu nu Hana — The Balsam Flower)
description: One of Okinawa's most cherished traditional folk songs, an ancient instructional ballad (琉歌) teaching moral values through the metaphor of the balsam flower (鳳仙花). Just as the red flower stains the fingertips, parents' teachings should stain the heart. Ten verses cover themes of respect for elders, humility, perseverance, and character. Sung in the Okinawan (Ryukyuan) language, this song is a beautiful introduction to the distinct culture and dialect of Okinawa.
